name: nucleation_slime_extender
description: A sticky piston, a slime block, a piston riding each side of the slime, and a lever. Vanilla drags both riders *and* the stone floor beneath the slime, shoving the whole row; this engine extends and pushes the slime alone. Same event count, different blocks — the difference is what the push structure gathers, not whether it fires. (From Nucleation, MIT, (c) 2025 Schem-at.)
